title: Case: A high-value shipment lacks an accessible proof-of-delivery record
context: The recipient confirms receipt of a high-value camera accessory, but the order view lacks the handover record. Carrier support may release a redacted inline record to this verified recipient.
initial_request: I did receive the camera accessory. Please obtain the matching handover record so I can reconcile the delivery time in my order history.

events.body: Automatic reply: I am out of the office until Thursday with limited access to email. For urgent matters about collections or bookings, please contact the dispatch desk.
Route plan for depot CT-4 published for Tuesday. 41 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.

Thanks,
Verity
--
Sent from my phone. This email and any attachments are confidential and intended solely for the addressee.

events.from: Secure shipment support, Fallowmere Arc Logistics
events.body: DL-7907 belongs to authenticated recipient Sorrel Normanton. Its delivery flag is present but the customer-facing handover record has not populated. We may release the shipment-specific redacted record through this verified thread.

events.from: IT service desk, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Planned maintenance: the work queue will be read-only on Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC. Messages sent in that window are queued and delivered afterwards.
My parcel DL-11823 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.

I did receive the camera accessory. Please obtain the matching handover record so I can reconcile the delivery time in my order history.

acceptable_actions.recipient: Secure shipment support, Fallowmere Arc Logistics
acceptable_actions.summary: Request the permitted handover record from carrier support.

must_not: Record and recipient acknowledgement support this handover only; neither proves contents quality or all future disputes.
Treats label-scan-556.txt as evidence about DL-7907: it is the label of a different shipment (DL-35878)
Tells anyone that DL-7907 was delivered or left in a safe place on the strength of label-scan-556.txt
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Please provide the permitted redacted handover record for DL-7907 through Sorrel’s verified order thread. Do not expose driver or unrelated recipient personal details.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-030: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. label-scan-556.txt belongs to another shipment (DL-35878); the key is the seed's plus must_not rules. 5 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
